part: Si24R1 (Nanjing Zhongke Microelectronics / CSM), order code 'Si24R1' tape and reel (p34)
package: QFN-20 4x4 mm, 0.5 mm pitch, exposed pad 2.65 x 2.65 mm nominal (p29)
kicad_symbol: RF:nRF24L01P (extends RF:NRF24L01). Pin numbers match the Si24R1 table on p7: 1 CE, 2 CSN, 3 SCK, 4 MOSI, 5 MISO, 6 IRQ, 7/15/18 VDD(VCC), 8/14/17/20 VSS, 9 XC2 = XO, 10 XC1 = XI, 11 VDD_PA, 12 ANT1 = RFP, 13 ANT2 = RFN, 16 IREF, 19 DVDD = VDD_D. The symbol has NO exposed-pad pin.
kicad_footprint: Package_DFN_QFN:QFN-20-1EP_4x4mm_P0.5mm_EP2.6x2.6mm (exists; EP 2.6 vs 2.65 nominal). Its pad 21 (EP) has no symbol pin: add a GND pin 21 or tie the pad in the generator.
pins: PA supply output: feeds L3, decoupled by C6||C7

circuit.value: figure says 10 nF, BOM table says '100uF' X7R 0402 (table entry is not credible for 0402; footnote recommends 100 uF only for coin-cell supplies)
16 MHz, +-60 ppm, CL 12 pF, ESR <= 100 ohm (p27, p30)
12-22 pF NP0 2% each (p30). For CL 12 pF about 18 pF each [my arithmetic, assuming ~3 pF stray]
2.2 nF X7R 10% and 4.7 pF NP0 +-0.25 pF
not mounted (not shown in the figure)

circuit.part: PCB inverted-F: KiCad RF_Antenna:Texas_SWRA117D_2.4GHz_Left/Right (no part); or chip antenna Walsin RFANT3216120A5T (1206) / Rainsun AN9520-245
circuit.source: KiCad library; JLCPCB listings (antenna datasheets not read)

supplies.rx: 15 mA @2 Mbps, 14.5 mA @1 Mbps, 14 mA @250 kbps
supplies.tx: 25 mA @+7 dBm, 16 mA @+4 dBm, 12 mA @0 dBm (p26-27)
supplies.power_on: 100 ms power-on delay after VDD >= 1.9 V (p8); crystal start 1.5-2 ms (p9)

logic.levels: VIH/VIL are NOT given in the datasheet; input voltage abs max 5.25 V (p26). Run at 3.3 V with the 3.3 V radio SPI
logic.can_io_run_at_1V8: not specified (supply minimum is 1.9 V, single supply) -> no
logic.spi: 4-wire, max 10 MHz (p19 Fsck), MSBit first per byte (p17); nRF24L01+ compatible = mode 0 [mem]
logic.reset: no reset pin; CE low at power-up keeps it in standby/shutdown
logic.note: when the MCU is not driving, CE/CSN/SCK/MOSI must be held at a defined level; MISO and IRQ float (p31)

to_expander: CE (needs >= 10 us high pulse to transmit, p9; expander latency only delays the start)
IRQ (expander input with interrupt, or leave unconnected and poll STATUS)

antenna.type: single-ended 50 ohm after the L1/L2/L3/C8/C9 network; datasheet layout uses a PCB antenna with no copper under it (p31)

notes: Bare chip is the better-stocked route: 7,987 chips at $0.87 versus modules SI24R1-Z (Silicontra, 12x12 mm, C5456962, 1,559, $1.60), SI24R1-ZTX (18x12 mm with PCB antenna, C42381996, 833), DL-Si24R1-A (C2894788, 404). Genuine NRF24L01P-R is C8791 (10,057, $5.03) and fits the same footprint and network class.
The matching network is the nRF24L01+ topology with the datasheet's own values.
pin_plan_conflicts: Only RF_CS_NRF_N is planned. CE and IRQ need two expander lines (or brain pins).
unverified: C1 value discrepancy (10 nF in figure vs 100 uF in table): use 100 nF + 10 nF + 1 nF [my choice]
